reviewer: promotion_historian (read-only independent reviewer; authored no implementation)
reviewMethod: Initial frozen source/contracts/provenance review and focused input reproduction; correction review including 14 controller tests and canonical/copy hash checks; final availability/evidence inspection. Reviewer performed no browser or GPU work.

findings.title: OS repeats revived cleared movement/look after pause/resume
findings.evidence: KeyW down, pause, enable, repeated keydown moved camera without a fresh press. Corrected controller ignores repeats; regression covers W movement and J look, then keyup/fresh press restores normal control.

producerCorrections.issue: Pond launch scripts did not enforce strict ports; verify replaced caller SCENE_PORT.
producerCorrections.resolution: Strict dev/preview ports; verify preserves SCENE_PORT and defaults to 4452.

producerCorrections.issue: Initial walking tree-test route encountered a real rock before its intended tree.
producerCorrections.resolution: Clear waypoint toward tree-15; both proximity-to-boundary and non-penetration assertions retained; final source and copy tests passed.

scope.tidebreak: Only BRIEF.md and PROMPT.md; no boat implementation, scaffold, dependencies or managed goal started here.
scope.waterEvidence: Explicitly authorized early promotion: one fishing consumer, neutral framework example and standalone copy proof; no claimed second game or new art score.
